analysis: Scabies is a skin infestation caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei. The standard treatment for scabies involves topical scabicides. Benzene hexachloride, also known as lindane, is a medication used to treat scabies. Erythromycin is an antibiotic, piperazine is an antihelminthic, and thiabendazole is also an antihelminthic, none of which are used for treating scabies.
